timotheus.name: Timothy
timotheus.why: Bible Atlas labels him with the KJV spelling "Timotheus"; the site's Plain names him Timothy (Acts 16:1; the letters).

john-25.name: John Mark
john-25.why: Bible Atlas labels him "John", though the entity is John Mark (aka Mark, Marcus) and is linked where the text says "Mark" (Colossians 4:10; 2 Timothy 4:11; Philemon 1:24) as well as "John" (Acts 12:12, 25; 13:5, 13).

jesus.name: Jesus Justus
jesus.why: This Bible Atlas id is "Jesus who is called Justus" (Colossians 4:11), a different person from Jesus Christ (jesus-2); the plain label "Jesus" made readers see two people named Jesus.

phygellus.name: Phygelus
phygellus.why: Bible Atlas spells the name "Phygellus" (the KJV form); the Greek and the site's Plain of 2 Timothy 1:15 have Phygelus.

pontius.name: Pontius Pilate
pontius.why: Bible Atlas labels him "Pontius"; the Plain calls him Pilate or Pontius Pilate (Matthew 27:2; 1 Timothy 6:13).
